'''Onions''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden vegetable]]. They can be planted in all seasons, and the bulb is edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] onion plants for their ''bulbs''.

[[File:ARS red onion.jpg|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''bulbs''.]]

{{D for Dwarf}}Some [[ogre]]s like onion plants for their ''layers''. [[Donkey]]s usually prefer cake or parfait.
